theme: An open Sunday, then north tomorrow.
greeting: A quiet Sunday, Dan — the one thing on the calendar is already behind you and the rest of the day is yours. The girls head back to Jen this evening, and you're on the 12:20 to Portland tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: December break still has no destination
needsAttention.detail: The three-week December trip with all four girls was due to be decided Sept 30 and books by Oct 15 — holiday inventory for six is the thinnest of the year. The default is a domestic shortlist unless someone wants international on refundable bookings only.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV isn't held yet
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out early. A refundable hold now costs nothing and takes the whole risk off the table.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive window starts tomorrow
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 off-week gap is when the Pathfinder goes Portland to St Pete, and you land in Portland tomorrow. Dates and the one hotel night on the route are still open.

schedule.title: Sunday review with Mike
schedule.detail: The weekly 15-minute board sweep — done earlier this morning.

flagged.title: KPMG chairman's connection invite on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: A connection request from a KPMG chairman and CEO is sitting in the inbox — worth a look given the board search, though it's just the LinkedIn notice.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, retail promos, and auto-notifications — NYT Cooking, Bloomberg, LinkedIn job alerts, travel and shopping blasts.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is actually waiting on a reply from you.

recipe.title: Onion Tart
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans into the season's roots, squash, and slow-cooked warmth.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + outdoor shower soap holder

acts.line: The 9 AM review with Mike was the only thing booked — the rest of the day came unscheduled.
An open stretch in St. Pete, the last full day before the flight north.
The girls hand back to Jen around six, and tomorrow's 12:20 to Portland sits just past it.
